items.summary: Users can now schedule Teams Channel Meetings from Win32 (Outlook classic client)GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Customize blocked file extensions for Weaponizable File Protection
items.summary: Microsoft Teams is expanding admin controls for Weaponizable File Protection. Administrators will be able to customize which file types are blocked in Teams to align with their organization's security requirements or continue using the Microsoft-recommended default list. This added flexibility helps organizations tailor file protection policies while maintaining a secure collaboration environment.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: SharePoint: New Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
items.summary: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android is redesigned around the personalized SharePoint Discover experience, bringing your most relevant files, sites, people, and news together in one place, with improved site browsing, in-app file previews, refreshed news and search, dark mode, and better performance.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Automatically complete Project Tasks when field work is finished
items.summary:
Keep project plans aligned with field execution by automatically completing a linked Project Task when its Work Order is completed.
When project work is carried out through Field Service, the Work Order often represents the execution of a specific Project Task. With this capability, organizations can configure Work Order Types so that completing the Work Order also completes the associated Project Task.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Bring project material plans into field execution
items.summary:
When the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled, material estimates created in a project plan can now create connected Work Order Products on the related Field Service work order. This allows project-planned materials to flow into Field Service without requiring project and field teams to recreate material lines, keeping both teams aligned on the same material plan.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
items.summary: Microsoft Purview is upgrading inline data protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business. The experience integrates with a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access grant control and simplifies configuration while removing current Purview policy restrictions. Admins can now use expanded conditions and condition combinations, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, configurable alerts and notifications, and rule match activities are visible in activity explorer.GA date: January

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Expanded inline protection for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
items.summary: Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention (DLP) policies will support browser inline protection for a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business. Admins can use existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities, helping extend consistent data security controls across more destinations.GA date: January CY2027Preview date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
items.summary: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Outlook: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
items.summary: If you don’t want to check spelling manually for every message—or you’re worried you might forget!—you can set Outlook to check spelling for you every time before sending emails.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Monitor tab
items.summary: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within Monitor tab at both a per-agent level and an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage, helping connect overall consumption to specific actions and experiences.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Agent Evaluations
items.summary: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly associated with their evaluations, including a breakdown of usage for eval generation, test runs and model grading/judgement. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage transparent throughout the development lifecycle.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History
items.summary: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
